headword: {正直|しょうじき}{一途|いちず}

definitions.gloss: earnestly honest; wholeheartedly sincere; single-mindedly upright
definitions.explanation: Describes a person who is thoroughly honest and sincere in everything they do, without any pretense or calculation. Combines the ideas of honesty and wholehearted devotion.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{正直|しょうじき}{一途|いちず}な⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧だ。
examples.english: He is an earnestly honest person.

examples.japanese: {正直|しょうじき}{一途|いちず}な⟦{性格|せいかく}→性格：03371_seikaku⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、⟦{嘘|うそ}→嘘：01796_uso⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦つけない→つける：00562_tsukeru⟧。
examples.english: With an earnestly honest personality, he can't tell lies.

examples.japanese: ⟦{祖父|そふ}→祖父：01452_sofu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{正直|しょうじき}{一途|いちず}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{生|い}きて→生きる：01184_ikiru⟧きた⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧で、⟦{地域|ちいき}→地域：01461_chiiki⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{信頼|しんらい}→信頼：03268_shinrai⟧⟦されていた→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: My grandfather lived a wholeheartedly sincere life and was trusted by the community.

notes:
A four-character compound (⟦{四字熟語|よじじゅくご}→四字熟語：15663_yojijukugo⟧) combining ⟦{正直|しょうじき}→正直：01562_shoujiki⟧ (honest; upright) and ⟦{一途|いちず}→一途：18242_ichizu⟧ (wholehearted; single-minded). Used as a na-adjective to describe someone whose sincerity is absolute and unwavering.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {正直|しょうじき}{一途|いちず}な⟦{人柄|ひとがら}→人柄：08163_hitogara⟧: earnestly honest character
- {正直|しょうじき}{一途|いちず}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{生|い}きる→生きる：01184_ikiru⟧: to live wholeheartedly and honestly
- {正直|しょうじき}{一途|いちず}な⟦{姿勢|しせい}→姿勢：00371_shisei⟧: an earnestly sincere attitude

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{実直|じっちょく}→実直：09186_jicchoku⟧: honest and straightforward — similar meaning but a single word
- ⟦{誠実|せいじつ}→誠実：14211_seijitsu⟧: sincere; faithful — more common, slightly broader
- ⟦{一途|いちず}→一途：18242_ichizu⟧: wholehearted; single-minded — one component, without the honesty emphasis
- ⟦{愚直|ぐちょく}→愚直：09185_guchoku⟧: stubbornly honest — implies honesty to a fault
